--- title: data.fetch_data.fetch_data --- ```python data.fetch_data.fetch_data( filename=None, dataframe=None, columns=None, index_col=0, parse_dates=True, dayfirst=False, timezone='UTC', ) ``` Fetches a dataset from a CSV file or processes a DataFrame. ## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters} | Name | Type | Description | Default | |-------------|------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------| | filename | [str](`str`) or [Path](`pathlib.Path`) | Full absolute path of the CSV file containing the dataset (e.g., ``'/home/data/my_data.csv'``). Required when dataframe is None. Use ``get_data_home()`` or ``get_package_data_home()`` to build the path, for example ``fetch_data(filename=get_data_home() / "my_data.csv")``. | `None` | | dataframe | [pd](`pandas`).[DataFrame](`pandas.DataFrame`) | A pandas DataFrame to process. If provided, it will be processed with proper timezone handling. Mutually exclusive with filename. | `None` | | columns | [list](`list`) | List of columns to be included in the dataset. If None, all columns are included. If an empty list is provided, a ValueError is raised. Default: None. | `None` | | index_col | [int](`int`) | Column index to be used as the index. Default: 0. | `0` | | parse_dates | [bool](`bool`) | Whether to parse dates in the index column. Default: True. | `True` | | dayfirst | [bool](`bool`) | Whether the day comes first in date parsing. Default: False. | `False` | | timezone | [str](`str`) | Timezone to set for the datetime index. If a DataFrame with naive index is provided, it will be localized to this timezone then converted to UTC. Default: "UTC". | `'UTC'` | ## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns} | Name | Type | Description | |--------|------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------| | | [pd](`pandas`).[DataFrame](`pandas.DataFrame`) | pd.DataFrame: The dataset with UTC timezone. | ## Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises} | Name | Type | Description | |--------|------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------| | | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If columns is an empty list, if both filename and dataframe are provided, if neither filename nor dataframe is provided, or if filename is not an absolute path. | | | [FileNotFoundError](`FileNotFoundError`) | If CSV file does not exist. | ## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples} ::: {#b98677ed .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} from spotforecast2_safe.data.fetch_data import fetch_data, get_package_data_home # demo02.csv is included in the package datasets path_demo = get_package_data_home() / "demo02.csv" df = fetch_data(filename=path_demo) df.head() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ```{=html}
